model_meta.description: A compliant mechanism in which a driver reorients an elastic plate to adjust its resistance to rotation between first and second units.

subsystems.description: Supports the driver and elastic member shaft and forms one side of the passage; disclosed embodiment comprises a base and tube.
Rotatably connected to the first unit about the passage; supports the second shaft of the elastic member. Disclosed embodiment comprises a disk and connectors.
Plate with coaxial first and second shafts rotatably connected respectively to the first and second units; deforms with relative unit rotation and provides adjustable resistance.

parts.description: Elastic plate joining the two coaxial shafts.
First shaft connected to the plate and rotatably connected with the first unit; engaged through the worm gear in the disclosed transmission option.
Second coaxial shaft connected to the plate and rotatably disposed at a second-unit connector.

subsystems.description: Driver rotates the elastic member through a predetermined angle; disclosed embodiment uses motor, worm and worm gear transmission.

parts.description: Motor driver in the disclosed embodiment.
Worm connected to the motor driver.
Worm gear engaged with the worm and connected to the elastic member first shaft (claim 2 option).

interfaces.interface_type: worm/worm-gear rotary transmission to first shaft

subsystems.description: Bearing with inner and outer collars connected respectively to the first and second units to support relative rotation.

ports.name: Inner collar connection to first unit
Outer collar connection to second unit

item_flows.name: Elastic-member adjustment rotation
item_flows.notes: Driver-mediated rotation about the coaxial shaft axis changes plate posture and resistance; claim 1.

item_flows.name: Relative unit rotation
item_flows.notes: Second unit rotates relative to the first about the passage; claims 1 and 3.

item_flows.name: Elastic-member second-shaft mounting rotation
item_flows.notes: Rotatable connection of the elastic member's second shaft to the second unit; claim 1.

steps.description: Driver rotates the elastic member about the co-axis of its first and second shafts through a predetermined angle.
The changed plate posture adjusts the elastic member's resistance to rotation of the second unit relative to the first unit.
When the second unit rotates relative to the first unit, the elastic member elastically deforms and resists that rotation.
